title: AS2: RegExp object and methods
description: Add RegExp literal support to the AS2 compiler (packages/core/src/as2). Parser: parse /pattern/flags as a RegExpLiteral node. Compiler: compile to ActionPush 'RegExp' + ActionGetVariable + ActionPush pattern + ActionPush flags + ActionPush 2 + ActionNew (0x40) to create a RegExp instance. Also support .test(), .exec(), .match() method calls (these just compile as regular method calls via ActionCallMethod). Add parser tests and compiler tests.
